problem: LinkedIn GET_COMPANY_INFO may return organization id as a numeric JSON value (18234216) while the publisher compared only against the full URN urn:li:organization:18234216, causing healthy organization-scoped OAuth connections to be rejected as reauth-required.
root_cause: String containment check assumed LinkedIn organization identity would always be returned in URN form.
fix: Normalize the canonical organization URN to its id component and accept either the full URN or the canonical numeric id in organization capability evidence.
prevention: Treat LinkedIn organization identity as equivalent across URN and numeric-id representations.
Keep provider organization capability proof separate from optional readback scope.
Never create a replacement publication claim after provider side-effect; resume the existing daily claim.
